payload.reason: The evidence suggests several potential improvements for the proposed memory-augmented architectures, including simplification for faster training, reduction of parameters, and integration with other models for better word retrieval.

claims.text: Future improvements could focus on simplifying the memory-augmented architectures to enhance training speed and reduce the number of parameters.
Combining memory modules with pointer softmax networks may improve the ability to store and retrieve specific words from previous utterances.
Accessing the NTM at intervals rather than at each decoding step could improve efficiency and practicality of the model.
